data.subject: Local Ledger for Heartland Advisors
data.body:
Hi,

Heartland Advisors' most recent 13F, for the period June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO, INBK, and PINE.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
